name: locks-in-main-test-617c6c002d/locks-functions-v.bal
spec_references: ## Statements: "[Lock statement](https://ballerina.io/spec/lang/master/#lock-stmt)" is supported; named worker declarations are not listed.

## Expressions: "[Start action](https://ballerina.io/spec/lang/master/#start-action)" and "[Wait action](https://ballerina.io/spec/lang/master/#wait-action)" are supported, but named worker declarations are not listed.
## Import declarations: ballerina/lang.runtime lists sleep; ballerina/lang.int lists fromString.
### Other invocation restrictions: method-call syntax includes error:message and string:toBytes.
reason: The case essentially depends on named worker declarations (worker w1/w2), which are outside the documented positive support lists. Its assertions require concurrent workers to contend for nested locks, preserve shared values across sleeps, release locks on return/break/panic, and propagate worker panic through trap wait. Support for lock, start and wait alone does not cover named worker declarations and their concurrency behavior.
unsupported_constructs: Named worker declarations and their concurrent execution/lock contention semantics
test_design_notes: Several assertions depend on sleep-based scheduling and read shared globals outside locks.
nextInsideLock increments i before checking i == 0, so its continue branch is never exercised.
